channel.title: StaticReel — Signal Log
channel.description: Verified weekly changes across Netflix, Max, Disney+, and Prime Video — price changes, cancellations, renewals, and policy updates.

item.title: Netflix renews The Gentlemen for Season 3 ahead of Season 2's premiere
item.description: Netflix confirmed a third season before Season 2 (streaming Sept 3) has even released. — An early renewal signals strong internal confidence in the show ahead of its next season debut. [Verified · Netflix Tudum]

item.title: Netflix confirms Outer Banks Season 5 is the final season
item.description: Tudum's official August 2026 roundup explicitly describes Season 5, which premiered Aug 20, as "the final season" of Outer Banks. — One of Netflix's flagship YA franchises is ending after five seasons — likely the single biggest story of the week. [Verified · Netflix Tudum]

item.title: Prime Video renews Sterling Point for Season 2
item.description: Amazon confirmed a second season order for Sterling Point. — One of the platform's newer originals gets a fast renewal, signaling strong internal confidence. [Verified · Amazon News (aboutamazon.com)]

item.title: Prime Video's Reacher Season 5 renewal confirmed/updated Aug 12
item.description: Amazon's article confirming Reacher Season 5 was originally published May 11 and updated Aug 12 with streaming details — the renewal itself was not first announced on this date. — Confirms Prime's biggest action franchise continues, with Neagley and Terminal List S2 also on the way. [Verified · Amazon News (aboutamazon.com)]

item.title: Prime Video sets Neagley premiere for Sep 16
item.description: All eight episodes of the Reacher spinoff premiere Sep 16, per Amazon's official page. — First concrete date for the spinoff since it was announced, giving fans a target. [Verified · Amazon News (aboutamazon.com)]

item.title: Prime Video sets The Terminal List: Season 2 premiere for Oct 21
item.description: All eight episodes premiere Oct 21, per Amazon's official page. — One of Prime's highest-profile originals returns after a multi-year gap. [Verified · Amazon News (aboutamazon.com)]
